title: Marex expands digital assets offering with rolling spot crypto
message_html: Marex expands digital assets offering with rolling spot crypto ...
snippet: Marex (NASDAQ:MRX), announced the launch of an OTC rolling spot crypto product for institutional clients, marking the latest step in the firm’s continued expansion of its digital assets offering.

title: StraitsX to bring first SGD-denominated stablecoin to Monad
message_html: StraitsX to bring first SGD-denominated stablecoin to Monad ...
snippet: StraitsX today announced plans to bring XSGD and XUSD to the Monad network in early 2027. XSGD is planned to become the first SGD-denominated stablecoin natively issued on Monad, expanding the currencies available to developers, businesses and institutions across the network.
